note: Hand-written romaji for kana readings the letter-for-letter rule would get wrong because a は (or へ) in them is said wa (e): consulted first by src/core/reading/romaji.ts, matched inside a reading. A を is always o and needs no entry. Found by listing every vocabulary reading and every phrase token of src/data/packs/ja that holds は, へ or を (see docs/audits/2026-11-10-ja-forms.md).
